name: MC's Revenge
source:
What if the main character of [url=/v21905]Doki Doki Literature Club![/url] becomes sentient and self-aware, similar to Monika? If he was awakened by the power of my coding and began to realize that this is all just a game? What will he do? Will he beat Monika and save his best friend?

[Edited from [url=https://github.com/firelightning13/DDLC-MCRevengeMod]Github[/url]]
translation:
如果[url=/v21905]Doki Doki文学俱乐部！[/url]的主角变得像莫妮卡一样有感情和自我意识怎么办？如果他被我编码的力量唤醒并开始意识到这只是一个游戏呢？他会做什么？他会打败莫妮卡并拯救他最好的朋友吗？

[编辑自[url=https://github.com/firelightning13/DDLC-MCRevengeMod]Github[/url]]
